caseName: J. A. Scriven Co. v. Rice-Stix Dry Goods Co.
caseNameFull: J. A. Scriven Company v. Rice-Stix Dry Goods Company
summary: Appeal from the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit.
attorneys: Mr. Arthur v. Briesen and Mr. Hans v. Briesen for the appellant. Mr. F. W. Lehmann and Mr. S. L. Smarts for the appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction. Farrell v. O’Brien, 199 U. S. 100; David Kaufman & Sons Co. v. Smith, 216 U. S. 610; § 6 of act of March 3, 1891, chap. 517, 26 Stat. 828. And see Hutchinson, Pierce & Co. v. Loewy, 217 U. S. 457.
